steps.do: Before you start: the server needs CALIBER_FEATURE_ARIA=true (Aria and Plans are off by default) and its background workers. This loop remediates things that already exist, so first run assets/setup_subject.py (it prints a workflow_id and an agent_id) and assets/seed_traces.py (it prints the 12 flagged trace ids). In the sidebar open Operate and click Plans. Paste the canonical sentence from intent.md into Goal, set Autonomy to Stop before each change and press Decompose goal.
fill: Our workflow's recent runs look weak - set up a review queue for the flagged traces and kick off a workflow calibration.
steps.see: The plan opens with the status draft.

steps.do: Read Plan steps. Aria drew three steps: review_queue.create, review_queue.add_items (depends on 1 prior step(s)) and workflow.calibrate (it depends on nothing). Nothing has run. Compare with expected-plan.json.

steps.see: The status becomes approved and an Execute button appears.

steps.do: Press Execute. Aria stops on Aria needs information (Provide the required inputs for step 1: Create review queue.). Fill name, description, questions and reviewers (JSON arrays) from triage-review.queue.json, press Continue plan, then Approve Approve step 1: Create review queue (review_queue.create)?.
fill: [{"key":"resolution_correct","title":"Did the workflow reach the correct resolution?","type":"pass_fail",...}, ...]

steps.do: Provide the required inputs for step 2: Enqueue traces for review. There is no queue id field: it is wired from the first step. Fill trace ids with a JSON array of the 12 ids seed_traces.py printed and assigned to, press Continue plan, then Approve.

Provide the required inputs for step 3: Calibrate workflow. Fill workflow id and agent id with the ids setup_subject.py printed (calibrate.json), press Continue plan, then Approve Approve step 3: Calibrate workflow (workflow.calibrate)?. Approving enqueues a real calibration job.
steps.see: The plan header reads running and the step waiting job; there is nothing to answer. The plan is parked on the job.
steps.asset: Plan parked on the calibration job

steps.do: Do not click anything. The page re-reads a running plan every five seconds, and the plan worker resumes it when the job finishes (about half a minute).
steps.see: On the simulated stack the status becomes failed: steps 1 and 2 done, step 3 failed with rejected: workflow calibration rejected: no candidate met calibration gates; quality delta +0.000 < epsilon 0.02 (a fake executor cannot make a candidate beat the baseline). With a real model the job can reach candidate_ready and the plan reads completed.
steps.asset: Plan settled by itself, ending where the job ended

steps.see: A row weak-runs-triage with 4 questions, the reviewer olga and 0/12 reviewed.

steps.do: Open the queue (Items (12)) and pick the trace of S19. Answer from support-runs.jsonl: Fail for Did the workflow reach the correct resolution?, missing_evidence for Primary failure mode, 3 for Severity (1-5), and the reference answer for What should the answer have been?. Press Submit review.
steps.see: The trace reads completed and the list row reads 1/12 reviewed. The answers are assessments on the trace; the expected answer is its expectation.

steps.do: State Calibrate the support workflow., press Decompose goal, Approve plan, Execute, fill workflow id with WF-does-not-exist and any agent id, and press Continue plan.
steps.see: The plan reads failed at once; the step shows workflow 'WF-does-not-exist' not found (HTTP 404) and does not read waiting job: no job was queued.

steps.do: State the same sentence under Stop before each change, approve and execute, fill the two real ids, press Continue plan, and at Approve step 1: Calibrate workflow (workflow.calibrate)? press Deny.
steps.see: The plan reads completed and the step skipped; no job was queued.
